definition_en: The ability to design, manage, and secure computer networks, protect systems from threats, and ensure data integrity and privacy.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk mereka bentuk, mengurus dan melindungi rangkaian komputer, melindungi sistem daripada ancaman, serta memastikan integriti dan privasi data.
typical_tasks_en:
• Configure the office firewall to block unauthorised access.
• Monitor network logs for signs of a phishing attack.
• Set up VPN access for remote staff and enforce two-factor authentication.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Konfigurasikan tembok api pejabat untuk menyekat akses tanpa kebenaran.
• Pantau log rangkaian untuk tanda serangan phishing.
• Sediakan akses VPN untuk kakitangan jarak jauh dan laksanakan pengesahan dua faktor.
inclusion_rules:
• The task involves configuring or managing network infrastructure
• The task requires implementing security measures or protocols
• The task involves monitoring for security threats or vulnerabilities
• The task requires responding to cyber incidents or breaches
• The task involves ensuring data privacy and access controls
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only using networks without managing them
• The user performs general IT support without security focus
• The task requires no understanding of network architecture or threats
• The user is simply following security policies without technical implementation
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task only uses a network or follows security policy without technical security work.

confusions.boundary_rule: Networks focuses on infrastructure security. Programming is software development.
confusions.example_task: Secure the API endpoints that the development team built.

confusions.boundary_rule: Technological literacy includes basic security awareness. Networks is specialised.
confusions.example_task: Configure the firewall and monitor network traffic.

confusions.boundary_rule: Networks secures data flow. AI analyses data.
confusions.example_task: Use AI to detect unusual network traffic patterns.
confusions.expected_labels: Networks and cybersecurity; AI and big data

examples.task_text: Configure the office firewall to block unauthorised access.
Monitor network logs for signs of a phishing attack.
Connect my laptop to the office Wi-Fi.
examples.reason: Basic network use, not management or security.
